mapper.select: SELECT id, task_name, task_type, task_category, description, condition_type, condition_value, reward_type, reward_value, reward_claim_mode, start_time, end_time, status, sort, created_at, updated_at FROM activity_task WHERE task_type = 'SIGN' AND task_category = 'DAILY' AND status = 'ENABLED' AND (start_time IS NULL OR start_time <= #{now}) AND (end_time IS NULL OR end_time >= #{now}) ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_task_progress SET current_value = LEAST(target_value, current_value + #{count}), status = CASE WHEN current_value + #{count} >= target_value THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE status END, complete_time = CASE WHEN complete_time IS NULL AND current_value + #{count} >= target_value THEN #{now} ELSE complete_time END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DOING'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_sign_record ( user_id, task_id, sign_date, continuous_days, cycle_day, base_reward_amount, extra_reward_amount, milestone_day, milestone_reward_amount, reward_amount, points_transaction_no, milestone_points_transaction_no, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{taskId}, #{signDate}, #{continuousDays}, #{cycleDay}, #{baseRewardAmount}, #{extraRewardAmount}, #{milestoneDay}, #{milestoneRewardAmount}, #{rewardAmount}, #{pointsTransactionNo}, #{milestonePointsTransactionNo}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, task_id, sign_date, continuous_days, cycle_day, base_reward_amount, extra_reward_amount, milestone_day, milestone_reward_amount, reward_amount, points_transaction_no, milestone_points_transaction_no, created_at FROM user_sign_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sign_date = #{signDate} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, task_id, sign_date, continuous_days, cycle_day, base_reward_amount, extra_reward_amount, milestone_day, milestone_reward_amount, reward_amount, points_transaction_no, milestone_points_transaction_no, created_at FROM user_sign_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sign_date < #{signDate} ORDER BY sign_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, task_id, milestone_day, reward_type, reward_value, status, created_at, updated_at FROM activity_sign_milestone_rule WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND milestone_day = #{milestoneDay} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, task_id, reward_type, base_reward_value, extra_reward_value, reward_value, source_type, source_id, member_level, idempotency_key, points_transaction_no, created_at FROM activity_reward_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, task_id, member_level, extra_reward_type, extra_reward_value, status, created_at, updated_at FROM activity_task_reward_rule WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND member_level = #{memberLevel} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT mp.code FROM user_membership um INNER JOIN member_plan mp ON mp.id = um.plan_id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND um.status = 1 AND um.end_time > #{now} ORDER BY um.end_time DESC, um.id DESC LIMIT 1
